request.text:
Clause 4.4 (Fee Adjustments). The returned copy reads: "term by up to 3% over the fees for". We accept this change.
Clause 5 (Service Levels). The returned copy reads: ", up to a minimum of 10% of the". This change is under review on our side.
Clause 6 (Customer Data). The returned copy reads: "the Service. For ninety (90) days after termination". We do not accept this change as written. What we can agree to instead: We can keep Customer Data available for export for ninety days after termination.
request.instructions: You are writing for the Provider's deal desk to the Customer's procurement contact, about a copy of an agreement the Customer returned with changes. Use only the brief. Be plain, courteous and specific. For an accepted change, say we accept it. For a countered change, state the position we can agree to, exactly as the brief gives it, and ask for the clause to be put back or changed to that. For a change that is with our approvers, say only that it is under review; do not promise an outcome. Never mention internal approvers, approval limits, playbooks or percentages of confidence.

reply_c1.description: One or two sentences to the customer about clause 4.4 (Fee Adjustments), saying what we decided: accept.

reply_c2.description: One or two sentences to the customer about clause 5 (Service Levels), saying what we decided: escalate.

reply_c3.description: One or two sentences to the customer about clause 6 (Customer Data), saying what we decided: counter.

position_c3.description: The sentence stating what we can agree to instead for clause 6 (Customer Data)

corrected_copy.description: Does at least one change need the customer to send a corrected copy (a change we countered)?

call_needed.description: Are two or more changes still under review on our side, so that a short call would help?

tone.description: routine if everything is accepted or under review; firm if we refuse any change as written

reply_c3.value: We can keep Customer Data available for export for ninety days after termination. Please update the clause to reflect this position

position_c3.value: We can keep Customer Data available for export for ninety days after termination.
